description: Structured extraction. Send text (up to 20,000 characters; 20 KB of UTF-8 is read) or a public page or PDF URL, plus a JSON Schema (up to 8,000 characters, no pattern keywords, $ref only inside it); returns JSON checked against your schema, after one repair attempt if needed. Use to pull fields from invoices, listings, filings or emails. Not for free-form summaries (use /v1/summarize). Typical response 3 to 10 s. Failed calls are not charged. Costs $0.01 (USDC, x402).

instructions.description: Optional: what to extract, in plain words.

json_schema.description: JSON Schema the result must match, up to 8,000 characters and 16 levels deep. No pattern or patternProperties; $ref only to #/ inside the schema, not recursive.

url.description: Or a public page or PDF to extract from. Send text or url.

name: quantagentshop_extract
title: Extract
